grid.lonlat_convention: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude (degrees)

centre.source: IAU Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, feature 'Jezero'

slope.computed_from: CTX DEM 20 m pixels; central differences (numpy.gradient)
slope.horizontal_spacing: north-south 20 m; east-west 20 m * cos(lat)/cos(lat_ts) per row (eqc map metres are true only at lat_ts)
slope.vertical_units: metres (USGS product page: 'Vertical Coordinate System Units: Meters')
slope.cell_rule: routing cell = 3x3 DEM pixels; passability uses max 20 m slope in cell, reporting uses mean
slope.limit_note: Prototype heuristic chosen by the team; not a NASA standard.

hirise.rule: Cells with >= 90% valid 1 m slopes use HiRISE: limiting slope = max(HiRISE p90 of 1 m slopes, CTX max 20 m slope); reported mean slope = HiRISE mean 1 m slope. Other cells use CTX only.
hirise.percentile_note: p90 rather than max: a single 1 m pixel is dominated by DTM noise or one boulder. Heuristic, not a NASA standard.
hirise.alignment: No resampling: HiRISE pixel centres mapped to CTX cells by x_ctx = x_hirise*cos(lat_ts_ctx), y_ctx = y_hirise (same sphere R, lon_0 = 0).
